styleLock.direction: clinical HVAC consumer commerce, flat colour-block graphic screens alternating with clean packshots
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating electric-blue #2B5BF0 graphic fields with one soft vertical light streak and warm off-white #F7F5F2 layout panels; brick-red #C0233C only for contaminant and spec blocks; deep navy #14276B for data and diagram plates
styleLock.lightingSystem: packshots lit bright even high-key at 5600K from the front-left with a soft fill and one soft contact shadow; graphic screens lit flat and shadowless with the same upper-left light direction across the whole set; macro lit with a cool low-intensity skimming sweep
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless warm off-white studio sweep #F7F5F2 for packshots, matte navy plates #14276B for diagram cells, real concrete floor and painted drywall only inside the two installation photos
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, oversized headline band, one short label row per element, generous margins, every word left as a blank slot or a callout placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: flat thin-line pictograms inside blank white circular chips, single stroke weight, no gradients, no shading, no captions
styleLock.presentationRules: pack always upright and square to the frame on graphic fields, identical scale between paired panels, filter media shown at the same edge-on or face-on attitude, product never clipped
noDrift: no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens
no inconsistent light direction between paired panels
no real brand marks, ratings or badge artwork
no invented numbers inside chart bars, spec blocks or ladder rungs
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical home-improvement HVAC ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of electric blue #2B5BF0, deep navy #14276B, warm off-white #F7F5F2 and one brick-red accent #C0233C; cool neutral lighting at 5600K, front-left key for packshots with one soft contact shadow and flat shadowless graphic light for screens, one consistent light direction; modern geometric sans-serif with oversized headline bands and one short label row per element; flat thin-line circular pictogram icons in white, single stroke weight, no gradients; graphic colour-block fields alternating with clean packshots and exactly two real photographs; stable upright square-to-frame product scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no photographic backgrounds on graphic screens, no inconsistent light direction, no real brand marks or badge artwork, no invented numbers.

provenance.notes: 11 张源主图逐图事实：001 暖白底正面包装，蓝/红/黄三色色块＋圆形图标点阵＋右侧枚数窗口＋下方一条尺寸带＋底部褶层视窗；002 左右分栏新旧包装同框，中间一枚白色箭头，右栏蓝色场；003 蓝色场上滤网斜 3/4 立放＋三条 Width/Length/Depth 引线＋右侧两块色底规格卡；004 纯文字信任屏，蓝色纵向光带背景；005 左半双柱柱状图（浅蓝与藏青两柱）＋右半红底一列圆形微粒图标；006 藏青方块四宫格等距线稿安装步骤，含编号圆点与中间分支字样；007 蓝框两格实景，一位女性跪在金属炉体旁塞入边框滤网、另一格手托滤网对墙式回风口（两格均露脸）；008 三盒不同色带头的同族包装并排立于蓝底；009 蓝色大字利益屏＋一枚日历线性图标行；010 平板外框内三行下载、扫码、提醒步骤（含源品牌应用图标与扫码框）；011 白底多档横向阶梯色块对照表＋顶部一行微粒线性图标。品类判定依据：实物为无电机、无电加热的替换式暖通空气过滤网，配暖气炉与中央空调回风箱使用，属家装暖通耗材，故 L1 逐字取「家装灯具」、L2 逐字取「建材」；未取「家用电器」（非电器整机，无电机与电加热），未取「家居日用/纸品清洁」（非清洁耗材），未取「电工」（与布线器材无关），源站类目仅作检索线索。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列名、平台与社会证明类背书字样、净化效率等级与全部尺寸数值主张、原图英文标题原句与脚注、应用商店图标与扫码框内容、007 两位模特的面容与身份（改为颈部以下裁切与仅露手部）、011 的档位数字与颜色档位含义、原平台店铺与评分字样。所有数值与等级一律改为空白参数位、空表格单元、空印章框与未填充的阶梯栏，产品一律以 {product} 占位，可复用的只是色块版式、机位、光位与分镜结构。
